# INSART — AI Growth Engineering (Industrial AI)

> INSART AI Growth Engineering helps industrial and operations-heavy businesses find where AI pays for itself, then designs and ships the integration—MES, ERP, vision, telemetry, and workflow automation—with a clear path to measurable outcomes. A free, structured proposal (about four pages) is offered within roughly five business days for qualified engagements.

INSART is the same engineering organization known for deep fintech work; this offering is framed for manufacturing, metallurgy, agriculture, logistics, food production, mining, oil & gas, and adjacent capital-intensive sectors. It emphasizes production systems and operator-facing tools—not generic slide-only AI strategy.

**Not in scope:** consumer growth retainers; “ChatGPT for everyone” without integration into systems of record; guarantees of funding or partnerships.

## Main

- [AI Growth Engineering landing](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/): Positioning, outcomes, credibility, case-study carousel, testimonials, and CTA to request an AI plan.

## Case studies

- [Metallurgy — coil & stock vision](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/cases/metallurgy-coil-vision.html): Multi-plant steel / service center; vision + WMS; coil ID and yard reconciliation.
- [Manufacturing — predictive maintenance](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/cases/manufacturing-predictive-maintenance.html): Many lines; vibration, temperature, and MES signals into one ranked maintenance queue.
- [Agriculture — crop intelligence](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/cases/agriculture-crop-intelligence.html): Imagery and soil sensors; early stress and pest risk.
- [Logistics — fleet routing](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/cases/logistics-fleet-routing.html): LTL routing vs traffic, dwell, and dock constraints.
- [Food production — vision QC](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/cases/food-line-vision-qc.html): Inline vision QC and batch traceability.
- [Mining — targeted extraction](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/cases/mining-targeted-extraction.html): Geology-aware targeting and pit routing with safety overlays.
- [Oil & gas — pipeline monitoring](https://ai-practice-kohl.vercel.app/cases/oilgas-pipeline-monitoring.html): Infrared and anomaly models along long right-of-way.
